text: Shifting policy so that all returns on purchases are minted into fungible reputation tokens paid proportional to reputation holdings instantiates the shift from capital to reputation and functions as a form of best efforts underwriting on a token opportunity.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance

abstract: All ROP is minted into FRT which, in turn, is paid out proportional to RNFT holdings. This instantiates the important shift from capital to reputation and shifts the incentives away from capital to reputation and can be seen as a form of best efforts underwriting on a token opportunity.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: capital to reputation ratio moving toward 50/50
